description: Notification server with Android and CLI clients (alternative to PushBullet).

promotion.reason: The pinned image was last rebuilt on 2022-09-11. Four years of unpatched base-image changes. Revisit when the definition pins a current release.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Anyone who can reach this address can read the notifications sent to it. It creates an administrator account on first start whose password you should change immediately.
